transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we discussed, we're planning to launch the peer-mediation program for the spring semester, and I need to get your input before I can give final approval to the operating plan. The current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts. Before I can approve the plan, I need each of you to report on your assigned checklist items. Let's go around the table — please share your report on your assigned area, and I'll record everything and note any required plan changes before making my final decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report on the roster and training status as the peer-mediation advisor. My classroom observation and training log show that M4 and M9 have not completed the required mediation practicum, while M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, and M12 have completed it. I recorded this in my advisor notes this week but have not yet entered it into the program roster.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: As the counselor, I need to report on the referral-screening requirements. My current student-services file review identifies active no-contact orders involving students Nia and Omar. Referrals involving either of these students must be screened out of peer mediation. I confirmed these no-contact orders with the families this week, but I have not yet added the screening requirement to the draft operating plan. This screening requirement needs to be incorporated into the plan before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: As the school psychologist, I need to report on the safety and supervision requirements. My safety review, which I finalized yesterday but have not yet attached to the launch proposal, finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts — they may not handle threats or moderate conflicts. Additionally, the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session, not one as currently proposed. These changes need to be incorporated into the plan before approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update the program roster to reflect that only the ten mediators who completed the required practicum (M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, M12) are listed; M4 and M9 are removed until they complete the practicum.
Add the referral-screening requirement to the draft operating plan: referrals involving Nia or Omar must be screened out of peer mediation due to active no-contact orders.
Revise the operating plan to limit student mediators to minor peer conflicts only (not threats or moderate conflicts) and assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session instead of one.
